clause: Panel group — Optics / lens correction / defringe [STU-RAW-009]

scope.summary: Add the Optics group: lens-profile correction removing geometric distortion, lens vignetting, and chromatic aberration with automatic profile match + manual override + profile selection; and a manual Defringe with purple/green fringe amount sliders, per-fringe hue-range selection, and a fringe-color sampler. Deduplicates Photoshop Optics + Affinity Lens panels. Lens profiles are Studio-native assets or imported profile data; NO vendor lens-profile service is a runtime dependency.
acceptance_criteria: lens profile correction + defringe; no vendor service dep; Argus + manual
expected_tests: test: distortion/vignette/CA correction + auto-match + manual override; defringe with hue-range sampler
test: no network/vendor lens-profile service dependency

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Optics (lens & defringe)

risk_if_missed: No lens correction; vendor-service dependency risk.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
